title: Declarative metadata hints for TypeScript SDK codegen and runtime validation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Proposal and implementation work to add a declarative metadata hints layer to the TypeScript SDK code generator. This ticket covers: (1) schema-level hint syntax that can be embedded in model output contracts (codegen-time only) to influence discriminators and optional runtime checks, (2) JSON Schema annotation generation for downstream tooling, (3) emitted Zod helper factories that capture these hints, and (4) runtime plumbing so streaming/ progressive parsers can consume hints to make earlier, safer partial-parses. Goal: reduce ambiguous union parsing at runtime, improve developer ergonomics for structured output, and provide a clear migration path for existing generated clients.
acceptance_criteria: A documented hint syntax (annotations in comments or JSDoc) that codegen accepts and emits into generated TypeScript types and JSON Schema output
Generated SDK includes Zod helper factories for at least three union-pattern examples used in internal evals (tagged discriminators, shape-based heuristics, and external-field routing)
Streaming parser uses hints to produce deterministic partial object shapes in at least two integration tests (chat streaming + structured output)
Backward compatibility: existing generated clients without hints continue to work unchanged; new clients opt into hints via codegen flag
Performance: added runtime validation with hints does not increase median cold-path latency by >5% in bench harness
Docs and migration guide published to Confluence and linked in the SDK repo README
progress_updates: 2026-03-10: Kickoff — drafted design doc outlining hint grammar and integration points. Decided on JSDoc-style @shapeHint syntax so hints can be authored alongside hand-written types.
2026-03-11: Prototype — added parser in codegen that recognizes @shapeHint and emits a 'hints' property on generated JSON Schema output. Verified with one existing model catalog entry.
2026-03-12: Engineering review — runtime team raised concerns about validator allocation when many small hints are present. Agreed to share Zod factory instances across model versions where possible.
2026-03-13: PR opened (#1234) with initial codegen support and two example SDKs generated. CI failing on streaming integration test due to partial-parse contract mismatch; investigating.
2026-03-14: Fixed streaming edge-case by deferring discriminator decision until required fields from hints are received. Integration tests now passing locally; pushing fixes to PR.
notes: Hint grammar chosen to be conservative: explicit tag fields preferred, but shape predicates allowed for legacy models
Trade-off: richer hints reduce runtime ambiguity but increase codegen surface area — keep hints opt-in
We will not alter public runtime semantics by default; codegen flag --enable-shape-hints toggles emitted helpers
Consider follow-up to surface hint-derived warnings in Console during model onboarding
